he.text: יְיָ יְיָ אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן · אֶרֶךְ־אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת · נֹצֵר חֶסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה ·

en.text: The Eternal is the immutable eternal being; an Omnipotent God, merciful and gracious, long-suffering and abundant in beneficence and truth; keeping mercy unto thousands, forgiving iniquity, transgression, and sin, and acquitting. Pardon thou
